instruction: Candid studio close-up photograph of two women posing playfully in front of a plain white wall. On the left, the woman with voluminous afro hair (R1) in a mauve shirt touches her cheeks with both hands, smiling at the camera. On the right, the woman with short brown hair (R2) in a striped shirt blows a kiss with both hands. They stand close together side-by-side under bright, soft frontal lighting.
